about_the_game:
Hex-Based Grid Building

Expand your empire on a hexagonal grid. Strategically place buildings to maximize bonuses, adjacency effects, and long-term growth.

Idle & Incremental Progression

Generate resources continuously—even when you’re offline. Return to a stronger, wealthier civilization every time you check in.

Building Upgrades & Synergies

Upgrade your buildings to dramatically boost their output, unlock new building types, and discover powerful synergies between placement and surrounding tiles and buildings.

Tech Tree & Progression Systems

Research technologies that improve efficiency, unlock advanced buildings, and introduce powerful automation systems that reduce micromanagement.  As you progress, your civilization evolves through multiple eras—each with its own unique mechanics and strategic opportunities.

Player Trading

Interact with other players by trading surplus resources in a simple, optional trading system. Sell resources you have in abundance, or buy resources for those you’re lacking, helping to smooth out bottlenecks and accelerate growth. Whether you're focused on production, expansion, or research, trading allows for smarter resource management and a touch of collaboration in an otherwise idle experience.

Prestige & Replayability

Once you've reached a key milestone, you can reset your empire through a prestige system, earning Building Cards to increase the output of buildings, making the next run faster and more strategic.

Time Travel

Unlock the ability to Time Travel, allowing you to return to a previous Age within your current game. Sacrifice your upgraded buildings to earn Time Travel Points, which can be spent on powerful meta-upgrades. Time Travel opens up advanced meta-strategies by letting you refine your empire through iterative runs.

  • Processor: Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics

short_description: Idle Empires is an incremental strategy game where you build and expand a thriving empire, one hex at a time. Place buildings, gather resources, and upgrade your empire automatically over time. Whether you’re actively playing or letting progress tick while idle, your empire is always growing.
